title: 第 9 讲：高频词群实战 II —观点句词群

reading.title: Stating Your Opinion at the Review

sentences.en: In the review meeting, the data suggest that our new pipeline saves us time every quarter.
sentences.zh: 评审会上，数据表明我们的新流水线每个季度都为大家节省时间。

sentences.en: The dashboard shows that the tests now run faster than before.
sentences.zh: 仪表盘显示，测试现在跑得比以前更快了。

sentences.en: But one issue remains: under heavy load（高负载）, the cache still breaks.
sentences.zh: 但还有一个问题：在高负载下，缓存依然会崩溃。

sentences.en: The fact is that the bug returns every time we push a big update.
sentences.zh: 事实是，每当我们推送一次大的更新，这个 bug 就会回来。

sentences.en: I argue that we must fix it before we ship.
sentences.zh: 我主张我们必须在上线交付之前修好它。

sentences.en: Some colleagues disagree; they claim the case is rare.
sentences.zh: 有些同事不同意；他们声称这种情况很罕见。

sentences.en: I do not think that proves we can wait.
sentences.zh: 我不认为那就能证明我们可以再等等。

sentences.en: My point is that we should act now.
sentences.zh: 我的观点是，我们应该现在就行动。

sentences.en: In case the review needs evidence（证据）, I will present the logs.
sentences.zh: 万一评审需要证据，我会出示日志。

sentences.en: So state your point first, and show the numbers that support it.
sentences.zh: 所以，先亮出你的观点，再展示支撑它的数字。

reading.translation: 评审会上，数据表明我们的新流水线每个季度都为大家节省时间。仪表盘显示，测试现在跑得比以前更快了。但还有一个问题：在高负载下，缓存依然会崩溃。事实是，每当我们推送一次大的更新，这个 bug 就会回来。我主张我们必须在上线交付之前修好它。有些同事不同意；他们声称这种情况很罕见。我不认为那就能证明我们可以再等等。我的观点是，我们应该现在就行动。万一评审需要证据，我会出示日志。所以，先亮出你的观点，再展示支撑它的数字。

keyPoints.sentence: In the review meeting, the data suggest that our new pipeline saves us time every quarter.
keyPoints.analysis: 骨架①：观点动词 suggest + that 宾语从句（呼应 L05）；data 形式为复数，谓语用 suggest；suggest 表「表明」时以数据 / 事实为主语

keyPoints.sentence: The dashboard shows that the tests now run faster than before.
keyPoints.analysis: show + that 从句：摆事实型观点动词，主语是「物」（dashboard / data / logs）；单数主语配 shows，主谓一致别丢 s

keyPoints.sentence: The fact is that the bug returns every time we push a big update.
keyPoints.analysis: 骨架②：观点名词 fact + be + that 表语从句；the fact is that… 把事实钉在句子主干上，比单说 the bug returns… 更有「亮观点」的架势

keyPoints.sentence: I do not think that proves we can wait.
keyPoints.analysis: prove + 宾语从句：that 是指示代词「那」作 prove 的主语，proves 后省略了宾语从句引导词（prove (that) we can wait）；否定前移到 think（I do not think…）

keyPoints.sentence: My point is that we should act now.
keyPoints.analysis: 观点名词 point + 表语从句：the point is that… 用来收尾落点；从句必须是陈述语序（we should act，不是 should we act）

keyPoints.sentence: In case the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.
keyPoints.analysis: in case 引出条件「万一 / 以防」：从句一般现在表将来（needs），主句用 will；这是观点句的「留后手」条件框

core.example: The data suggest that our new pipeline saves us time every quarter.
core.extraExample: I suggest that we review the pull request together.
core.extraExampleZh: 我建议我们一起评审这个拉取请求。
core.collocations: suggest that… 建议 / 表明…… ｜ suggest doing sth 建议做某事 ｜ suggest a fix 提出修复方案 ｜ It is suggested that… 据建议……

core.example: The dashboard shows that the tests now run faster than before.
core.extraExample: The report shows that users prefer the simple version.
core.extraExampleZh: 报告显示用户更喜欢简洁的版本。
core.collocations: show that… 表明…… ｜ show the data 展示数据 ｜ show up 出现 ｜ as the data show 如数据所示

core.example: I argue that we must fix it before we ship.
core.extraExample: She argued that the old design had real value.
core.extraExampleZh: 她主张旧设计有真正的价值。
core.collocations: argue that… 主张…… ｜ argue for / against 赞成 / 反对 ｜ argue the point 论证观点 ｜ argue with sb 与某人争论

core.example: I do not think that proves we can wait.
core.extraExample: One test can prove that the fix works.
core.extraExampleZh: 一个测试就能证明这个修复是有效的。
core.collocations: prove that… 证明…… ｜ prove sth to sb 向某人证明 ｜ prove right / wrong 证明对 / 错 ｜ prove yourself 证明自己

blocks.text: 观点句不是「我觉得」堆出来的，而是两个固定骨架撑起来的：**骨架① 观点动词 + 宾语从句**（把观点装进宾语位，呼应 L05）；**骨架② 观点名词 + 表语从句 / in case 条件框**（用名词把观点钉在句子主干上）。

rows: suggest
建议；表明（委婉）
suggest that…
The data suggest that our new pipeline saves us time every quarter.
show
表明（摆事实）
show that…
The dashboard shows that the tests now run faster than before.
argue
主张；论证（摆理由）
argue that…
I argue that we must fix it before we ship.
prove
证明（拿证据）
prove that… / prove + 名词
I do not think that proves we can wait.
The fact is that…
陈述事实（表语从句）
The fact is that the bug returns every time we push a big update.
The point is that…
落到论点（表语从句）
My point is that we should act now.
in case + 从句
万一 / 以防（条件框）
In case the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.

blocks.text: 记法：**动词骨架讲「谁在说」**（suggest 委婉、show 摆事实、argue 摆理由、prove 拿证据），**名词骨架讲「说什么」**（fact 是事实、point 是论点、case 是情形）。
转述别人的观点时，主句（claim / argue / state / say）后面的从句一律用**陈述语序** —— 这是 L05「语序陷阱」在观点句里的复用。

rows: "The case is rare."
They claim (that) the case is rare.
that 可省；从句保持「主语 + 谓语」
"Why did the fix fail?"
She stated why the fix failed.
疑问词引导的转述从句也用陈述语序；时态呼应 stated → failed
"We should act now."
He argued that we should act now.
情态动词 should 原样保留

blocks.text: **时态呼应**同 L05：主句过去 → 从句相应过去；客观真理 / 习惯性事实保持一般现在。**自检用「盖住主句法」**：盖掉 They claim / She stated，剩下的必须是一个不倒装的完整陈述句。

notes.heading: 观点句的收放：先观点后证据

blocks.text: 写作中观点句要「先收后放」：**先亮观点（收）**，一句说清主张；**再挂证据（放）**，用数据 / 日志 / 案例支撑。顺序反了，读者翻到段末还不知道你要说什么。

items: **立骨架句（收）**：My point is that we should act now. / I argue that we must fix it before we ship.
**挂证据（放）**：The data suggest that… / The dashboard shows that… / In case the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.
**收尾留后手或让步**：In case… / Even if the case is rare, the bug is real.

blocks.text: 一段一个观点：三个观点挤在一句里，读者一个也记不住。观点句放段首，证据跟在后面，段落自然成立。

rows: He suggests me to fix the cache first.
He suggests that I fix the cache first.
suggest 不接「人 + to do」，只接 that 从句 / doing
The dashboard show that the tests run faster.
The dashboard shows that the tests run faster.
单数主语 + shows（主谓一致）
My point is which we should act now.
My point is that we should act now.
表语从句用 that，不用 which
She stated what does the dashboard show.
She stated what the dashboard shows.
转述从句一律陈述语序（盖住主句法）
In case the review will need evidence, I will present the logs.
In case the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.
in case 从句用一般现在表将来

output.prompt: 用 3 句复述这场评审会的观点（线索：数据说明了什么 → 问题在哪 → 论点如何支撑）。
output.reference: 线索：数据说明什么 → 问题在哪 → 论点如何支撑
output.sample:
The data suggest that our new pipeline saves us time every quarter, and the dashboard shows that the tests run faster. （骨架①两连：suggest / show + 宾语从句）But one issue remains: the cache still breaks under heavy load. The fact is that the bug returns with every big update. （骨架② The fact is that…）I argue that we must fix it before we ship, and my point is that we should act now. （argue / The point is that…）
（范文仅供参考：每句至少含一个本讲骨架即可，不要求逐词一致。）

output.prompt: 以你最近一次评审 / 技术讨论为场景，写 4~5 句观点句：至少 1 个「观点动词 + 宾语从句」、1 个「观点名词 + 表语从句」、1 个 in case 条件句和 1 句转述他人观点，顺序上「先观点后证据」。
output.reference:
参考起点：
The data suggest that the new pipeline saves us time.
My point is that we should fix the cache first.
In case the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.
Some colleagues claim the case is rare.
output.sample:
The data suggest that our new pipeline saves us time. （观点动词 + 宾语从句，先亮观点）
The dashboard shows that the tests now run faster. （show + 宾语从句，挂证据）
My point is that we should fix the cache first. （观点名词 + 表语从句，落论点）
In case the review needs evidence, I will present the logs. （in case 条件框）
Some colleagues claim the case is rare. （转述他人观点，陈述语序）

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 4~5 句中含 1 个「观点动词 + 宾语从句」、1 个「观点名词 + 表语从句」、1 个 in case 条件句、1 句转述他人观点；段落顺序「先观点后证据」

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 对照 3.4 五类错误逐句排查（suggest 不接「人 + to do」、表语从句用 that、转述从句陈述语序、in case 从句不用 will、主谓一致）；一段只落一个观点

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 四类句式齐备 + 无 3.4 常见错误 + 先观点后证据，即通过

output.prompt: 对照 3.4 常见错误表逐句排查你写的观点句，再按 3.3 检查段落是否「先观点后证据」。
output.reference: 排查顺序：suggest / argue 的接续 → 表语从句引导词 → 转述语序与时态 → in case 的时态
output.sample:
自检示例：
❌ He suggests me to fix the cache. → ✅ He suggests that I fix the cache.（suggest 不接「人 + to do」）
❌ The point is which we should act. → ✅ The point is that we should act.（表语从句用 that）
❌ In case the review will need evidence, … → ✅ In case the review needs evidence, …（in case 从句不用 will）
逐句排查完毕，观点句全部通过。

practice.title: 选词填空 — suggest / show / argue / prove，注意形态

questions.stem: The data ___ that our new pipeline saves us time every quarter.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（语法规则）：data 为复数形式名词，谓语用原形 suggest；依据链②（改写还原）：把 data 换成 the numbers → The numbers suggest…，还原成立。

questions.stem: The dashboard ___ that the tests now run faster than before.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（主谓一致）：dashboard 是单数第三人称，动词加 s → shows；依据链②（排除法）：show 原形只配复数主语（These numbers show…），与本句单数主语冲突。

questions.stem: She ___ that we should fix the cache before we ship.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（搭配规则）：argue that… 后接完整从句（we should fix…）；依据链②（改写还原）：还原为直接引语 "We should fix the cache before we ship."，转述后成立。suggests 同样接 that 从句、句意亦通。

questions.stem: One log line does not ___ anything; we need more evidence.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（形态规则）：does not 后动词用原形 prove；依据链②（排除法）：proves / proved 都不能跟在 does not 后面。

questions.stem: These numbers ___ that the bug returns every quarter.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（主谓一致）：numbers 是复数主语，动词用原形 show；依据链②（改写还原）：换成主语 the data → The data show…，同骨架成立。suggest 语义亦通；prove 语气过强不取。

questions.stem: Yesterday he ___ that the case was rare.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（时态呼应）：Yesterday 标记过去时 → argued，从句相应过去（was）；依据链②（排除法）：现在时 argues 与 yesterday 的时间标记冲突。suggested / showed 同为过去时、句意亦通。

practice.title: 观点句骨架判断 — ① 观点动词 + 宾语从句 / ② 观点名词 + 表语从句 / ③ in case 条件框

questions.stem: The data suggest that the new pipeline saves us time.
options: ① 观点动词 + 宾语从句
② 观点名词 + 表语从句
questions.explanation: 依据链①（骨架定义）：suggest 是观点动词，that 从句整体作它的宾语 → 骨架①；依据链②（排除法）：句中没有「观点名词 + be」主干，也没有 in case。

questions.stem: The fact is that the bug returns every quarter.
options: ① 观点动词 + 宾语从句
② 观点名词 + 表语从句
questions.explanation: 依据链①（骨架定义）：The fact is that… = 观点名词 fact + be + 表语从句 → 骨架②；依据链②（改写还原）：换成 The point is that the bug returns every quarter.，结构不变，仍是名词骨架。

questions.stem: In case the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.
options: ① 观点动词 + 宾语从句
② 观点名词 + 表语从句
questions.explanation: 依据链①（骨架定义）：in case 引出「万一」条件 → 骨架③；依据链②（排除法）：观点动词 / 观点名词都不在主干位置，主句是 I will present the logs。

questions.stem: My point is that we should act now.
options: ① 观点动词 + 宾语从句
② 观点名词 + 表语从句
questions.explanation: 依据链①（骨架定义）：The point is that… = 观点名词 point + 表语从句 → 骨架②；依据链②（改写还原）：同义改写 The fact is that we should act now.，骨架一致。

questions.stem: The dashboard shows that the tests run faster.
options: ① 观点动词 + 宾语从句
② 观点名词 + 表语从句
questions.explanation: 依据链①（骨架定义）：show 是观点动词，that 从句作宾语 → 骨架①；依据链②（排除法）：主干 The dashboard shows… 是「主语 + 谓语」，不是名词 + be 结构。

questions.stem: In case the build breaks, we revert the update.
options: ① 观点动词 + 宾语从句
② 观点名词 + 表语从句
questions.explanation: 依据链①（骨架定义）：in case + 从句引出条件 → 骨架③；依据链②（改写还原）：可改写成 If the build breaks, we revert the update.，仍是条件框。

practice.title: 改错 — 每句 1~2 处错误，改出正确的观点句

questions.stem: He suggests me to fix the cache first.
questions.reference: He suggests that I fix the cache first.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（搭配规则）：suggest 不接「人 + to do」，只接 that 从句 / doing；依据链②（改写还原）：还原直接引语 "I should fix the cache first." 再转述，成立。

questions.stem: She stated why did the fix fail.
questions.reference: She stated why the fix failed.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（语序规则）：转述从句一律陈述语序（主语 + 谓语），why 从句也不能倒装；依据链②（时态呼应）：主句过去 stated → 从句相应过去 failed（对照 L05）。

questions.stem: My point is which we should act now.
questions.reference: My point is that we should act now.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（引导词规则）：表语从句用 that，不用 which；依据链②（改写还原）：换成 The fact is that we should act now.，同一骨架成立。

questions.stem: In case the review will need evidence, I will present the logs.
questions.reference: In case the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（时态规则）：in case 从句用一般现在表将来，不用 will；依据链②（改写还原）：改写为 If the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.，条件句同规则。

practice.title: 判断下列 5 处正误 — ✓ 正确的打勾，✗ 错误的写出改正句

questions.stem: The data suggest that we need more time.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（主谓一致）：data 形式为复数 → suggest；依据链②（骨架核对）：观点动词 suggest + that 宾语从句，骨架①成立。

questions.stem: He argues me to wait for the next review.
questions.correction: He argues that we should wait for the next review.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（搭配规则）：argue 不接「人 + to do」；依据链②（改写还原）：还原直接引语 "We should wait for the next review." 再转述，成立。

questions.stem: The fact is that the cache still breaks under heavy load.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（骨架核对）：The fact is that… 观点名词 + 表语从句，骨架②成立；依据链②（语序核对）：that 从句内部是陈述语序 the cache still breaks…。

questions.stem: My point is that should we act now.
questions.correction: My point is that we should act now.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（语序规则）：表语从句内部是陈述语序，should 不提前；依据链②（改写还原）：从句还原成独立句 We should act now.，是陈述句而非疑问句。

questions.stem: In case the logs show the bug, I will open a ticket.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（时态规则）：in case 从句一般现在（show），主句将来（will open）；依据链②（骨架核对）：in case 条件框成立，与课文句同构。

practice.title: 观点句骨架改写（中译英）— 按括号内指定的骨架翻译成英文

questions.stem: 数据表明这个修复为我们节省了时间。（suggest + 宾语从句）
answers: The data suggest that this fix saves us time.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（骨架规则）：suggest + that 宾语从句，从句用陈述语序（this fix saves…）；依据链②（改写还原）：换回中文「数据表明……」，语义与骨架一一对应。

questions.stem: 事实是这个 bug 每季度都会回来。（The fact is that…）
answers: The fact is that this bug returns every quarter.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（骨架规则）：The fact is that… 观点名词 + 表语从句；依据链②（改写还原）：换成 The point is that this bug returns every quarter.，骨架一致、语义相近。

questions.stem: 万一评审需要证据，我会出示日志。（in case）
answers: In case the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（时态规则）：in case 从句一般现在（needs），主句将来（will present）；依据链②（改写还原）：可改写成 If the review needs evidence, I will present the logs.。

questions.stem: 我不认为那就能证明我们可以再等等。（I do not think that proves…）
answers: I do not think that proves we can wait.
questions.explanation: 依据链①（结构规则）：否定前移到 think（I do not think…），that 是指示代词「那」作 prove 的主语；依据链②（改写还原）：还原为 I think that proves (that) we cannot wait.，语义对应。

practice.title: 观点写作 — 写一段 4~5 句的评审观点（真实工作场景即可）

questions.stem: 写一段 4~5 句的评审观点（真实工作场景即可），要求：一个「观点动词 + 宾语从句」、一个「观点名词 + 表语从句」、一个 in case 条件句、一句转述他人观点，并做到「先观点后证据」。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 4~5 句中含 1 个「观点动词 + 宾语从句」、1 个「观点名词 + 表语从句」、1 个 in case 条件句、1 句转述他人观点；段落顺序「先观点后证据」

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 对照 3.4 五类错误逐句排查（suggest 不接「人 + to do」、表语从句用 that、转述从句陈述语序、in case 从句不用 will、主谓一致）；一段只落一个观点

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 四类句式齐备 + 无 3.4 常见错误 + 先观点后证据，即通过
